description.describe_ch: 本課程主要目的為加強統計國際書報閱讀訓練。課堂上協助同學接觸各種各種統計英文書報資訊，透過閱讀相關報刊及雜誌，教師引導同學認識並討論各項管理議題，培養學生觀察及分析問題能力。
description.describe_eh: The main purpose this course is to strengthen English reading training. In the classroom, students are assisted in accessing various English books and newspapers. By reading relevant statistics newspapers and magazines, teachers guide students to understand and discuss various business issues, and cultivate students’ ability to observe and analyze problems.

textBooks.tpb_book_en:
There is no specific book for this course. Most of the materials used are statistical reports, financial and business magazines such as Havard
magazines, Oxford Magazines and American statistician association.

readings.tpc_book_en:
1. UNITED NATIONS New York and Geneva, 2009, "Making Data Meaningful Part 1: A guide to writing stories about numbers",
ISBN:ECE/CES/STAT/NONE/2009/4.
2. Robert T. Stewart, "Adventures in Statistics: How We Live in a World of Numbers",(Springer Cham, 2024, First Edition), IX,122.ISBN:
978-3-031-61283-1.
3. Statistical Magazine and Report Links
The Havard magazines, Oxford Magazines and American statistician association, etc. are found from the following links:
https://www.sfmagazine.com/#sort=%40publishz32xdate%20descending
https://ourworldindata.org/
https://www.resourcefulfinancepro.com/
https://www.fintechweekly.com/
https://hbr.org/
https://www.fm-magazine.com/
https://www.resourcefulfinancepro.com/
https://www.firmofthefuture.com/

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Item 1: Attendance (5%) is part of  Learning process file record (individual/group). That 5 % is for class attendance and 25% is for all  assignments.
Item 2: Oral Presentation includes Written report + Report Presentation + Q/A
Item 3: Final presentation will be assigned to the other teacher
 
The following ponts matter in grading:  attendance and absence, classroom interaction and participation in discussions, assignment submission and lateness, assessment, cheating and plagiarism, or bonus points, etc.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Polices 課堂規則 :
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for
the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和
預計時間。
4. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and
such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵
照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Course Reminder 課程提醒 :
The instructor may make slight adjustments to the course schedule and content if needed.
授課老師得依各班狀況微調授課進度及內容.
In special circumstances, the instructor may adjust the grading proportions related to Assignments, Midterm  and  Final  Term.
在特殊情況下，授課教師得視情況調整作業、期中考與期末考之成績比例。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.
2. Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.
3. Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.
 
學術誠信與行為準則
  1. 誠信與倫理行為：學生在學術活動中應展現誠信與倫理行為，嚴禁抄襲及篡改資料。
  2. 抄襲：應正確引用資料來源，若未經適當標註而使用他人作品，則構成抄襲。
  3. 考試作弊：考生須遵守考試規定，若在考試期間使用未經授權之資料或與他人串通，即視為作弊行為。
